translation_notes: prefixes: OWL->owl, RDFS->rdfs (RDF and XSD are imported but never referenced in the region body).

the nested `for r in g.objects(c, RDFS.subClassOf): if prop in g.objects(r, OWL.onProperty): if filler in g.objects(r, pred): return True` is a single existential over a 3-triple join -- it returns True as soon as ONE r satisfies all three conditions together, which is exactly what a single joined m{ } plus bool() expresses: `bool(m{ {c} rdfs:subClassOf ?r . ?r owl:onProperty {prop} . ?r {pred} {filler} }(g))`. `pred` is itself a parameter (a URIRef) used in PREDICATE position via interpolation -- no special-casing needed, term interpolation is position-agnostic.

fixture.ttl covers: C1 with two restrictions on subClassOf (several solutions of the head pattern, collapsing correctly to one bool()), a PlainSuperclass neighbour that IS a subClassOf of C1 but carries no owl:onProperty at all (must not satisfy the join even though the first triple matches), and C2 whose one restriction has the right property but the wrong filler (false/zero-solution case). Verified directly against original.py: True/False/False for the three driver cases.
